rules.title: Boston rent stabilization home rule petition (not enacted)
rules.requirement: This bill would have let Boston limit rent increases. It was sent to a study order in 2024 and did not become law.
rules.requirement_es: Este proyecto de ley habría permitido a Boston limitar los aumentos de renta. Fue enviado a una orden de estudio en 2024 y no se convirtió en ley.
rules.coverage_text: Proposed home rule petition for the City of Boston; it was sent to a study order and not enacted.
rules.quote: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections

rules.title: Boston tenant eviction protections home rule petition (not enacted)
rules.requirement: This bill would have let Boston adopt eviction protections for tenants. It was sent to a study order in 2024 and did not become law.
rules.requirement_es: Este proyecto de ley habría permitido a Boston adoptar protecciones contra el desalojo para inquilinos. Fue enviado a una orden de estudio en 2024 y no se convirtió en ley.
rules.coverage_text: Proposed home rule petition for the City of Boston; it was sent to a study order and not enacted.
rules.quote: An Act petition for a special law authorizing the city of Boston to implement rent stabilization and tenant eviction protections
